## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows GitFlow (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, …)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes (tests added/updated where relevant)
- [ ] `npm run audit` is clean (no new high/critical advisories)
- [ ] Docs updated when behaviour changed
- [ ] Any new dependency is justified and permissively licensed
